notes.about: JSON has no comments, so the notes are kept here. This is the input of the lab that is its own: what the grid shows and how. The layout of the A2 sheet, the totals and the Excel addresses come from a2-step1-input.json, a copy of docs/architecture/forms/edu-a/a2-step1-input.json in the uis-d-platform GitHub repository. Same format as docs/architecture/forms/edu-a-grid/a2-grid-step1-input.json there.
notes.LABEL_COLUMNS: The 2 columns on the left of the grid, with the type of institution and the sex. title: the header. width: in pixels.
notes.VALUE_COLUMN: The value column of each level. title: the header. width: in pixels. align: the alignment of the number.
notes.CODE_COLUMN: The code column of each level, a list to pick from. title: the header. width: in pixels. align: the alignment of the letter. codes: the codes in the list and the only codes accepted (rule 2).
notes.COMMENT_COLUMN: The comment column of each level. title: the header. width: in pixels. align: the alignment of the text.
notes.TOTAL_FILLS: The fills of a total cell, as in the A2 sheet: value light blue, code darker blue.
